contact.basis: Dry Broadway entrance footway,1.2m beyond midpoint of native street facade; selected before terrain and geometry. Doorway/kerb position is approximate.

verticalDatum: Source-specific USGS CA_LosAngeles_B23 one-metre DEM; provider catalog NAVD88. No local survey-datum transformation; model uses provider-relative dry footway datum.
attribution: USGS National Map3DEP, CA_LosAngeles_B23 source-specific elevation export
method: Original uncompressed F32 GeoTIFF preserved before model geometry; explicit locked dataset127960 with no visualization function. Pillow pixel reader used for build; independent stdlib TIFF decoder compares every original pixel and reproduces all derived sample values. Pixel-centre bilinear sampling in native geographic frame; no flattening or fitting.
limitations: One-metre source/export and one-metre review sampling do not establish surveyed foundation contact. Hidden foundations, paving interpolation and later site changes remain uncertain.
Provider catalog acquisition2024-07-01 is source metadata, not an independent local field survey.
Source is a catalog-selected urban bare-earth DEM, not a facade or sidewalk survey; default coarse Earth terrain compatibility is not certified.
